notes: The FAQ says there are no additional costs or fees beyond travel to and from campus for the last week, and it does not say who pays that travel. Phone (443) 885-3964. Check the program page for the application window.
name: Summer Academy of Actuarial and Mathematical Sciences (SAAMS)
org: Morgan State University, School of Computer, Mathematical and Natural Sciences
what_you_do: Four weeks of college-level math and intro actuarial science classes, plus field trips, professional development sessions and career exploration.
who_can_apply: Students about to enter 11th or 12th grade. Recent graduates must plan to study actuarial science at Morgan in the fall. Competitive application and a phone interview.
pay_detail: No cost to attend. Pay is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Application dates are not posted. Students hear a final decision by late May.
how_to_apply: Apply through the SAAMS program. Some students get a phone interview. Email msusaams@morgan.edu for application updates.
